blocks.text: Nucleus ki banawat samajhne ke liye un forces ki fitrat jaanna zaroori hai jo nucleons ko jore rakhti hain; is se pehle fitrat ki bunyadi forces jaan leni chahiyein. Kaainat ki zahiri pecheedgi ke bawajood is ke tamam taamulat chaar bunyadi forces se chalte hain jinhein fundamental forces kehte hain. Yeh forces nanhe atoms se bari galaxies tak har paimane par cheezon ki harkat, taamul aur rawayya qaboo karti hain. Chaar bunyadi forces gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear force aur strong nuclear force hain.

items: Gravitational force: chaaron mein sab se kamzor magar lambi range wali force. Yeh kashish ki force hai jo ajsaam ke gravitational taamul se paida hoti hai; yeh un ke masses ke hasil-e-zarb ke seedhe aur faasle ke murabbe ke ulat tanasub mein hai. Suraj ya bare sayyaron jaise bhaari ajsaam ke liye yeh aham hai, magar atomi satah par na-qabil-e-zikr kamzor hai.

Electromagnetic force: electric aur magnetic field ke taamulat ki zimmedar. Gravity ki tarah yeh bhi inverse-square qanoon par chalti hai magar gravity se kahin taqatwar hai. Yeh atomi banawat aur kimiyai bonding se le kar bijli, magnetism aur roshni ke phailao tak bohat se mazahir chalati hai. James Clerk Maxwell (1861) ne chaar bunyadi equations banayin jinhon ne bijli aur magnetism ko electromagnetism mein mila diya; inhon ne dikhaya ke electric aur magnetic fields ek hi electromagnetic force ke do pehlu hain.

Strong nuclear force: sab se taqatwar kashish ki force. Electromagnetism maadde ko jore rakhta hai magar yeh nahi batata ke nucleus kaise juda rehta hai; sirf electromagnetism aur gravity hon to nucleus bikhar jaye. Nucleus ki paidari batati hai ke dono se taqatwar ek force hai: strong nuclear forces nuclei ko jore rakhti hain. Yeh sirf nucleus ke andar hoti hain, is liye short-range forces hain, aur tamam nucleons ke darmiyan ek jaisi kashish ki force hain. Protons strong force se ek doosre ko khainchte hain jabke bijli se dhakelte hain, aur neutron, neutral hone ke bawajood, strong force se doosre neutrons ya protons ko khainch sakta hai.

Weak nuclear force: radioactive decay, khaas kar beta decay, aur neutrinos wale taamulat ki zimmedar. Doosri bunyadi forces ke ulat weak force zarron ki pehchan (identity) badal sakti hai, jo ise sitaron mein nuclear fusion aur na-paidar nuclei ke decay jaise amal ke liye lazmi banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Strong nuclear force aur electric force mein kya mushabehat aur farq hai (short question 12.3)? Strong force nucleus ko kaise jore rakhti hai (short question 12.7)?
blocks.explanation: Dono bunyadi forces hain jo nucleus ke zarron par lagti hain, aur dono gravity se kahin taqatwar hain. Electric force sirf charges par lagti hai, khainch ya dhakel sakti hai, inverse-square se ghatti hai aur la-mehdood range rakhti hai; strong force taqreeban sau guna taqatwar, nucleons ke darmiyan hamesha kashish wali, protons aur neutrons par barabar, aur sirf taqreeban 10^-15 m range wali hai. Nucleus ke andar padosi nucleons ki taqatwar kashish protons ke darmiyan electric dafa par ghalib aati hai, to nucleons jure rehte hain; neutrons dafa barhaye baghair kashish barhate hain.

items: Chaar bunyadi forces: gravity (sab se kamzor, lambi range, kashish, bhaari ajsaam ke liye aham), electromagnetic (inverse square, gravity se kahin taqatwar; Maxwell 1861), strong (sab se taqatwar, chhoti range, tamam nucleons mein kashish, nuclei jore rakhti), weak (beta decay aur neutrinos; zarron ki pehchan badalti).
Table 12.1: strong 1 (10^-15 m se kam), electromagnetic 10^-2 (la-mehdood), weak 10^-13 (10^-18 m se kam), gravity 10^-38 (la-mehdood).
